Phase 5: Mechanical Engineering Workbench (Bearing Interchange + Live Dynamic SVG Pulley Drive Simulation).
Phase 6: Digital Machine Ledger (Factory Profile Bookmarks & 1-Tap WhatsApp Reorder).
Phase 7: Emergency FAB dynamic state (Saturday midnight + off-hours breakdown mode).

Phase 9: Supabase PostgreSQL Database Schema, REST client bridge, and 66+ item seed catalog with 10 units stock each.
